description: This file contains definitions for displaying tool summaries, including a data structure for summaries (ToolDisplaySummary), a registry for tool display configurations (ToolDisplayRegistry), and related helper functions for loading configurations, resolving display data, and formatting strings. It appears to be a utility module for handling the presentation of tools within an application, including configuration loading and string formatting.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A data structure representing a summary of a tool's display information, including name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail. It provides computed properties for formatted detail and summary lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: A singleton-like registry handling loading configuration for tool displays, resolving display summaries based on input parameters, and providing default configurations. It manages internal structs representing the configuration schema.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a ToolDisplaySummary object based on the provided tool name, arguments, and optional metadata. It determines display properties such as emoji, title, label, verb, and detail, utilizing configuration and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the tool display configuration JSON from the app resources and decodes it into internal structures. Falls back to default configuration on failure.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default ToolDisplayConfig object with predefined tools and fallback settings.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title string from a given tool name, capitalizing words and handling certain abbreviations.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by trimming, replacing underscores with spaces, and handling whitespace.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for 'read' actions, including path and optional offset and limit.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Retrieves the path detail from the provided arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Returns the first non-nil, non-empty string value from args corresponding to a list of keys.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value (string, number, boolean, array, or dictionary) into a pretty-printed string suitable for display.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Fetches a nested value from the arguments based on a dot-separated key path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the home directory path with '~' in a string for brevity.
